meta.title: Admin Console
meta.description: Operations console for users, channels, models, rate cards and statistics.

auth.heroDescription: Manage user accounts, tune channel weights, maintain model mappings, generate redeem code batches, and review stats and logs.
auth.noAccountHint: No account? Contact the ops team.
auth.twoFactorSent: A code was sent to your admin email and is valid for 5 minutes
auth.twoFactorHint: After 5 wrong attempts the code is invalidated and you must sign in again.
auth.serviceUnavailable: Sign-in service is unavailable, please retry later
auth.noToken: Signed in but no session credential was returned

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.requestsTrendDesc: Daily requests over the last 14 days (Beijing time)
dashboard.spendTrendDesc: Daily spend over the last 14 days

users.title: Users
users.description: Search, ban / unban, adjust balance, gift, reset password, bind rate cards
users.adjustDescription: Settled {balance}, reserved {reserved}, available {available}. Negative adjustments cannot eat into reserved funds.
users.adjustNonZero: Adjustment amount must be a non-zero number
users.giftDescription: Gifted amounts only increase the balance
users.resetLocalPassword: Reset the login password for this local account
users.passwordMin6: Password must be at least 6 characters
users.bindDescription: Pick a rate card, or unbind

providers.title: Providers
providers.deleteConfirm: Delete provider {name}? Its channels will become unavailable.

channels.title: Channels
channels.editDescription: Leave the API Key blank to keep the current one
channels.circuitThreshold: Circuit-break threshold (¥; auto-breaks when remaining ≤ this; blank = 0, breaks only when depleted)
channels.importDescription: Paste a JSON array; each item has provider (provider name), name, apiKey, optional models / weight / priority
channels.imported: {count, plural, one {# channel imported} other {# channels imported}}

models.title: Model mappings
models.description: External model name → upstream real model + unit price
models.unitToken: Text model · per-token pricing (input / output / cache)
models.delistConfirm: Delist model mapping {name}? It will no longer be served (historical billing and channel bindings are kept; it can be restored anytime)
models.delistSuccess: Delisted (status becomes "Delisted" in the list; restorable)
models.createDescription: Map an external model name to the upstream real model
models.contextInvalid: Must be a positive integer (blank = unlimited)
models.chooseUnitHint: Select a pricing method first; price inputs will follow it.
models.tiersTitle: Tiered prices (check a tier to price it by its param value; none checked = flat price)
models.tierValueTitle: Request param value used for billing (must match exactly)
models.tiersFillError: Checked/added tiers need a param value and unit price (or uncheck them)
models.tiersHint: Param values must match the request exactly; pre-auth conservatively uses the highest tier price, settlement prices by the actual request params, and misses fall back to the flat price.
models.unitModeHint: Unit: ¥ / {unit}; tier misses bill at the flat price
models.tokenModeHint: Unit: ¥ / million tokens; blank cache write price = no cache write fee
models.isFreeLabel: Explicit free model (¥0 authorization, no balance/quota reserved)
models.advanced: Advanced (fallback models / param rules / billing policy / limits / status)
models.bindDescription: Check the channels serving this model (fully replaces current bindings)
models.channelsBound: {count, plural, one {# channel bound} other {# channels bound}}
models.testTitle: Send a minimal real generation per channel to verify the mapping
models.testDescription: Sends a minimal real generation per bound channel (prompt "1" + max_tokens 1). Paid models cost fractions of a cent per run.
models.noBoundChannels: No channels bound to this model yet; bind first, then test.

rateCards.title: Rate cards
rateCards.coefficientRange: Coefficient must be 0.001-9.999 with at most 3 decimals
rateCards.deleteConfirm: Delete rate card {name}? Fails if users are bound.
rateCards.createDescription: Set a coefficient (for discount or markup)

rateLimits.title: Rate limits
rateLimits.description: Centrally manage RPM·TPM limits for users / models / channels / keys; users also have an overdraft limit, users and keys a daily spend limit (effective immediately after changes)
rateLimits.rpmPositive: RPM must be a positive integer
rateLimits.tpmPositive: TPM must be a positive integer
rateLimits.creditNonNegative: Overdraft limit must be an amount ≥ 0
rateLimits.dailySpendNonNegative: Daily spend limit must be an amount ≥ 0

plans.title: Plans
plans.description: Subscription and booster pack plans (price / quota shown with points)
plans.deleteConfirm: Delete plan {name}? Fails if active subscriptions exist.
plans.grantDescription: Grants this pack to a user: charges {price}, adds {points} points to their balance.
plans.createDescription: Set type, price, period and plan quota (quota is deducted as official price × coefficient)
plans.namePlaceholder: e.g. Standard monthly / Premium yearly / Booster pack

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.cancelConfirm: Cancel this subscription? Remaining quota is forfeited, no refund.
subscriptions.changeDescription: Upgrade to a higher tier or adjust seats; the system settles automatically by remaining quota and price difference.

channelFunds.title: Channel funds
channelFunds.description: Stock in and adjust channel purchasing funds (with payment order no. and voucher screenshot, traceable)
channelFunds.rechargeDescription: Top up purchasing funds at the upstream provider; a payment order no. and voucher screenshot can be attached.
channelFunds.adjustDescription: Correct purchasing funds (positive = add, negative = deduct); deduction cannot make funds negative.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.description: Acquisition fund parameters (signup gift / referral bonus / commission rate) — changes take effect immediately and are fully audited
marketing.saved: Marketing parameters saved (effective from the next action; history is not recalculated)
marketing.formDescription: Changes apply immediately: signup gift / referral bonus apply to the next signup, commission rate to the next daily settlement; already-booked entries keep the parameters of their time.
marketing.referralBonus: Referral signup bonus (¥/user, both sides, 0 = off)
marketing.commissionRate: Referrer commission rate (invitee daily spend × rate, 0–1, 0 = off)
marketing.giftWarning: Signup gift is on — make sure Turnstile verification is configured, otherwise mass sign-up abuse is possible.

referrals.title: Referrals
referrals.description: Referral relations and payout ledger; banning stops future payouts, booked history stays
referrals.bannedToast: Banned (future commissions stopped, booked history stays)

modelMarket.title: Model market
modelMarket.description: Sync multi-source catalogs into the library (channel sources list directly; dictionary sources land as drafts for review); USD prices are pre-filled as your selling price via rate × buffer, and submitting confirms them. Every pricing keeps a full audit trail (catalog price × rate → prefill → submit).
modelMarket.channelReadyText: The {name} channel is ready — just check and import.
modelMarket.needsKeyText: First import from {name} requires the platform API Key (creates a channel, stored AES-encrypted).
modelMarket.referenceHint: Dictionary source: imports land as drafts (unlisted); review prices then list them manually in Model mappings.
modelMarket.noSources: No catalog sources available (sources are registered server-side).
modelMarket.apiKeyRequired: First import from {source} requires the platform API Key
modelMarket.importedDraft: {count, plural, one {# model imported as draft (review in Model mappings)} other {# models imported as drafts (review in Model mappings)}}
modelMarket.imported: {count, plural, one {# model imported (prices effective as submitted)} other {# models imported (prices effective as submitted)}}
modelMarket.overridePlaceholder: Override rate (current {rate}; blank = clear back to auto)
modelMarket.fetchedMeta: {source} catalog fetched at {time} · {count, plural, one {# model} other {# models}}
modelMarket.selectAllTitle: Select all on this page (selection accumulates across pages; import batch limit 200)
modelMarket.cacheWriteTitle: Cache write price (Anthropic 1.25×/2× of input; 0/default charges as input)
modelMarket.contextTitle: Context window (tokens); defaults to the catalog value
modelMarket.historyButtonTitle: Price history: rates and prefill basis of past imports/changes
modelMarket.goneSuffix: — no longer in the catalog; review them in Model mappings.
modelMarket.noHistory: No catalog import records (manual price edits in Model mappings are not listed).
modelMarket.footerMain: Prices are ¥ per million tokens; USD-source prefills = catalog price × effective rate (auto ×(1+buffer) or manual override); submitting confirms your selling price.
modelMarket.footerReference: Dictionary imports land as drafts; review then list.
modelMarket.footerTest: After import, use the flask icon in Model mappings to test each channel. Each billed request also records the base rate at that time (usage_logs.fx_rate) for reconciliation.
modelMarket.namesRequired: External name and real model are required

redeemBatches.title: Redeem code batches
redeemBatches.description: Bulk-generate redeem codes for gifts / campaigns
redeemBatches.generateDescription: Codes are shown in plaintext only once — save them immediately
redeemBatches.generated: {count, plural, one {# code generated} other {# codes generated}}
redeemBatches.revealed: {count, plural, one {# code generated (save it now)} other {# codes generated (save them now)}}

notifications.title: Alerts
notifications.description: Push events like channel disabled / dead billing to webhook (HMAC signed) or email
notifications.testQueued: Test event queued (worker will deliver shortly)

paymentOrders.title: Payment orders
paymentOrders.description: Online payment orders and crediting status (crediting happens automatically via provider callback)
paymentOrders.closeConfirm: Close this pending order? Its callback will no longer be able to credit it.

auditLogs.title: Audit log
auditLogs.description: Every admin write operation on system objects
auditLogs.searchPlaceholder: Search action / target type / target ID

billingOperations.title: Billing review
billingOperations.description: Manual review of settlement dead letters (invariant violations); every action requires a version check and is written to the audit log.

logs.title: Request logs
logs.description: Filter by time, user and status code

usageLogs.title: Usage logs
usageLogs.description: Every charge (including estimates); estimated = provider did not return usage or the request was cancelled — billed on delivered content
usageLogs.reasonCancelled: Request cancelled early; estimated on delivered content
usageLogs.reasonMissingCompleted: Provider returned no usage (completed normally); estimated on delivered content
usageLogs.reasonMissingNonstream: Provider returned no usage (non-streaming); estimated on response content

tracing.title: Tracing
tracing.description: Data from the built-in trace receiver (trace_spans, rolled by daily partitions); shares the billing database and supports request_id correlation.
tracing.emptyHint: No data. Make sure trace-receiver is running and services point OTEL_TRACES_MODE=otlp at it.
tracing.noSpans: No span data for this request
tracing.viewTrace: View the trace for this request
tracing.noSpanData: No span data for this trace.
tracing.noTopologyData: No channel call data in this window (services must be wired to trace-receiver with real traffic).
tracing.topologyDescription: Cross-trace aggregation ({hours}h window): gateway → per-channel call volume, success rate, latency and last error. Green ≥95% / amber ≥70% / red <70%; edges with error rate ≥30% animate. Drag nodes; minimap to navigate.
tracing.ttftDescription: Channel first-token latency ({hours}h streaming samples, P50/P95) — upstream = attempt sent → first upstream byte; client = pipeline entry → first token delivered. A large gap means many channel-switch retries.

settings.twoFactorDescription: When enabled, signing in requires the correct password plus a 6-digit code sent to your email (valid for 5 minutes). Admin: {email}
settings.smtpHint: Requires SMTP configured server-side (a personal mailbox with an SMTP authorization code works). Enabling is rejected when unconfigured — it never silently degrades to password-only.
